annotations.title: Read Google Ads lead form submissions

description: The people who filled in a Google Ads lead form: each submission’s time, the answers (name, email, phone and any custom questions), the Google click id, and the campaign, ad group and lead form it came from, newest first. Filter by campaignId, adGroupId, assetId (the lead form asset) and since / until (YYYY-MM-DD); limit up to 1,000 (default 100). An empty answer means none that Google still holds for this account and filter, not proof that no form was ever submitted. These are the advertiser’s own leads and contain personal details: show them to the user who asked and do not copy them anywhere else unless asked. Read-only, free.

adGroupId.description: only submissions from this ad group

assetId.description: only submissions to this lead form asset

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's default account

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, submissions on or after this day

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, submissions on or before this day

name: list_google_ads_lead_submissions
title: Read Google Ads lead form submissions
